name: HIP 71618

planets.name: B
planets.note: Substellar companion (M6-M8, ~2700 K, ~30-100 Mjup depending on prior) on a nearly edge-on, high-eccentricity ~11 au orbit; discovered via joint Gaia/Hipparcos astrometric acceleration and SCExAO/CHARIS + Keck/NIRC2 direct imaging as part of the OASIS survey. Candidate Roman Space Telescope Coronagraph technology-demonstration target.

paper.title: OASIS Survey Direct Imaging and Astrometric Discovery of HIP 71618 B: A Substellar Companion Suitable for the Roman Coronagraph Technology Demonstration

images.credit: El Morsy et al. 2025 (crop; companion B, NIRC2 Lp)

paper.title: OASIS Survey: Direct Imaging and Astrometric Discovery of a substellar companion to HIP 71618

notes: HIP 71618 B was discovered by the OASIS survey, combining a Hipparcos-Gaia astrometric acceleration with SCExAO/CHARIS (JHK, 2024-2025) and Keck/NIRC2 (Lp) direct imaging (El Morsy+2025); separation ~0.3 arcsec (~11 au). Dynamical mass 60-65 Mjup (prior-dependent); atmospheric fits favor M6-M8, Teff ~2600-2800 K.
